# std.compiler

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Compiler services: diagnostics, types, definitions, references, symbols,
and completions of a source file (checked with its project, if any),
checks of proposed edits in their project, and diagnostic explanations. Each call runs `lang query` (the language
server's analysis) as a subprocess; positions are 1-based lines and
columns in characters.

## Types

### `Check`

```lang
struct Check { pub ok: Bool, pub diagnostics: List<compiler.Diagnostic>, pub inputs: List<compiler.Input>, pub unused_overlays: List<String>, pub roots: List<compiler.Root>, pub tests: List<String>, pub tasks: List<compiler.TaskSite> } derive(Codec, Display)
```

The result of checking a project with proposed file contents.

### `Input`


## Functions

### `check_project`

```lang
fn check_project(path: String, files: Map<String, String>) -> Result<Check, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Check the program `path` belongs to (each entry point and task, as
`lang check` does) with `files` (path, relative to the program's
directory, to proposed text) in place of the files on disk. Nothing is
written: check an interface change and its consumers together before
saving any of them.

### `check_source`

```lang
fn check_source(source: String) -> Result<List<Diagnostic>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Diagnostics of a source text, checked as a file on its own.

### `completions`

```lang
fn completions(path: String, line: Int, col: Int) -> Result<List<Completion>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Names that can be written at a position (after `x.`: members of `x`).

### `definition`

```lang
fn definition(path: String, line: Int, col: Int) -> Result<Option<Location>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Where the name at a position is defined.

### `diagnostics`

```lang
fn diagnostics(path: String) -> Result<List<Diagnostic>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Diagnostics of the program `path` belongs to (empty when it checks).

### `explain`

```lang
fn explain(code: String) -> Result<String, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

The explanation of a diagnostic code such as `E0301`.

### `hover`

```lang
fn hover(path: String, line: Int, col: Int) -> Result<Option<String>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

The type or signature at a position.

### `references`

```lang
fn references(path: String, line: Int, col: Int) -> Result<List<Location>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Every use and the declaration of the name at a position.

### `symbols`

```lang
fn symbols(path: String) -> Result<List<Symbol>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Definitions in a file, with their types.
